config.title: Source Insight C
config.indexRoots: Directories (workspace-relative) to index recursively. Empty means nothing is indexed until you run **Source Insight: Configure Index Roots**.
config.exclude: Glob patterns excluded from indexing. Supported syntax: `*` (within a path segment), `**` (any depth), `?` (single character).
config.maxFileSizeKB: Skip source files larger than this size in KB.
config.concurrency: Number of worker threads used while building the index.
config.searchLimit: Maximum number of symbols returned by one search.
config.autoReindexOnSave: Re-parse a file automatically when it is saved, created or deleted.
config.enableCallHierarchy: Also register the native VS Code call hierarchy provider (right-click a function to show callers/callees interactively).
config.followSymlinks: Follow symbolic links while walking the indexed directories.
